rho_reference.protocol: PROTOCOL.md 'Decision rule (frozen)': matched rho of the family, rho-neg (Van Oorschot-Wiener on {P, -P}, r-adding walk, 16 jumps below 2^30 and 32 above, distinguished points with floor(log2 r / 4) bits, one addition a walk start, short-cycle escape by doubling, answer verified) for ic-a, ic-b, ic-c1, ic-c2, ic-gls-neg; rho-psi for ic-gls-psi
rho_reference.scope: Headline cell: torsion family (cofactor 4, 6 curves), log2#E = 40, best IC arms ic-b and ic-c2 against matched rho-neg, 2 IC targets and 8 rho targets a curve.
rho_reference.unit: GAE (group-addition equivalents). IC: counted F_p multiplication equivalents (inversion = 4) divided by c_add, the measured mult-eq of one affine addition on the same curve (24 at inv-cost 4). Rho: counted group additions plus doublings, 1 GAE each. Unpriced native operations of every arm priced at w GAE each (w = 0, 0.1, 1).
